title: Fixed Inverted-T Datum Frame and Articulated Pointing Arm

A frame collar holds two successive jointed reach arms with three broad clamp discs; the terminal head carries one long finite blunt stylus with a separate stop collar and rear grip. A dedicated broad-foot rear carrier supports the empty tool at its crossbar, without a copied statue, workpiece or measuring result. All visible numeric geometry is newly authored, not imported old pantograph arms, a height-gauge beam, or a vise. One model zero scenes, four opaque constant PBR appearances, metres and native Z up. Fixed stylized display only: no working bearings, calibration, actual point transfer, copy accuracy, historical reconstruction, articulation, manufacture, stability or safe handling claim. No rig, animation or interaction.
